definitionZh: 弹性收缩 CSS 属性设置弹性项的弹性收缩系数. 如果所有弹性物品的大小大于弹性容器,弹性物品可以根据其弹性收缩值收缩以适应. 每条弹性线的负自由空格在线的弹性项之间分布,弹性收缩值大于0.
sourceDefinition: The flex-shrink CSS property sets the flex shrink factor of a flex item. If the size of all flex items is larger than the flex container, the flex items can shrink to fit according to their flex-shrink value. Each flex line's negative free space is distributed between the line's flex items that have a flex-shrink value greater than 0.
